Thank you for sharing an idea for Soundboard Maker!

## Need or problem to solve
What problem would you like to solve? When would this improvement be useful?

## Suggested improvement
Describe the feature you would like to see and how it should work.

## Alternatives or additional context (optional)
Have you considered a different solution? You may add an example or a screenshot with private details removed.

> **Privacy:** do not share personal audio files, account details, tokens or private information.
